name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central Sector Scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India, paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual direct cash transfer to bank accounts
3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months
100% centrally funded direct benefit transfer (DBT)

eligibility.criteria_summary: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land holding in their names.

application_steps: Visit official PM-Kisan Portal or nearest CSC center
Fill New Farmer Registration form with Aadhaar and land details
Submit land ownership documents for local Patwari verification

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stage with minimal premium rates.
benefits: Comprehensive crop loss protection against drought, flood & pests
Maximum premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops
Direct claim settlement into farmer's bank account via DBT

eligibility.criteria_summary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

application_steps: Enroll through nearest bank branch or CSC within cut-off date
Pay applicable premium based on crop and area
Receive insurance certificate and preserve for claim

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Provides farmers with timely access to credit for agricultural operations, post-harvest expenses, maintenance, farm asset maintenance and allied activities at interest rate of 4% p.a.
benefits: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at concessional 4% interest per annum
No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.6 lakh
Flexible withdrawal and repayment options

eligibility.criteria_summary: Individual farmers, owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, share croppers and self-help groups.

application_steps: Visit nearest bank branch or cooperative bank
Fill KCC application form with land holding details
Submit documents and receive credit limit within 15 days

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Ensures water availability to every agricultural farm, achieves convergence of investments in irrigation and promotes sustainable water conservation practices with Har Khet Ko Pani and More Crop Per Drop approach.
benefits: Micro-irrigation subsidy up to 55% for small/marginal farmers
Drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment at subsidized rates
Watershed development and water conservation infrastructure

eligibility.criteria_summary: All categories of farmers with preference to SC/ST and small & marginal farmers.

application_steps: Contact local Agriculture Department or district office
Apply online through state agriculture portal
Get site inspection done and receive subsidy approval

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides a report card with crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers to farmers to improve productivity through judicious use of inputs.
benefits: Free soil health testing every 2 years
Crop-specific nutrient and fertilizer recommendations
Helps reduce input costs and increase yield

eligibility.criteria_summary: All farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in India.

application_steps: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or Agriculture Extension Officer
Submit soil sample from your field
Receive Soil Health Card within 30 days with recommendations

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (MGNREGA)
description: World's largest employment guarantee scheme providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year
Statutory minimum wages paid within 15 days
Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any rural household adult willing to do unskilled manual work. SC/ST households get priority.

application_steps: Register at Gram Panchayat and obtain Job Card
Submit written application for work to Gram Panchayat
Receive work within 15 days or get unemployment allowance

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach in a participatory manner by mobilizing farmers into groups and providing support for organic farming certification and market linkage.
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare assistance for 3 years
Free organic certification under PGS-India
Market linkage support and e-trading platform access

beneficiary_types: Farmers forming clusters of 50+ for organic farming
eligibility.criteria_summary: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in clusters of minimum 50 farmers.

application_steps: Form a cluster of 50 farmers in your village
Apply through state agriculture department
Get cluster registered and start organic transition

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services - savings accounts, remittances, credit, insurance and pension in affordable manner to low-income groups.
benefits: Zero balance savings account with RuPay debit card
₹2 lakh accident insurance cover
₹30,000 life insurance cover under PMJJBY
Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 after 6 months

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age without a bank account.

application_steps: Visit nearest bank branch with Aadhaar or any valid ID
Fill account opening form
Get instant account number and RuPay card

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme offering renewable term life insurance of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason at annual premium of only ₹436.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance coverage for all causes of death
Very low annual premium of only ₹436
Auto-debit facility from bank account
No medical examination required

eligibility.criteria_summary: Anyone aged 18-50 with a bank account and Aadhaar can enroll.

application_steps: Visit bank or net banking portal
Fill PMJJBY enrollment form
Give auto-debit consent and get enrolled

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage of ₹2 lakh for accidental death and full disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability at annual premium of only ₹20.
benefits: ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death/total disability
₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability
Only ₹20 annual premium - auto-debited from account

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any Indian citizen aged 18-70 with a savings bank account.

application_steps: Login to internet banking or visit bank branch
Enroll under PMSBY scheme with auto-debit consent
Receive enrollment confirmation

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector to ensure a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 at age 60, depending on contributions.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000 per month after age 60
Government co-contribution of 50% or ₹1,000/year for 5 years (for eligible)
Spouse and nominee get pension/corpus after subscriber's death

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any Indian citizen aged 18-40 years with a savings bank account.

application_steps: Visit nearest bank or post office
Fill APY enrollment form selecting desired pension amount
Set up auto-debit for monthly contributions

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides micro credit up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises through Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishore (₹50K-₹5L) and Tarun (₹5L-₹10L) loan categories.
benefits: Collateral-free loans from ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakh
3 categories: Shishu, Kishore, Tarun based on need
MUDRA card for working capital withdrawals
Covers manufacturing, trading, services & allied activities

eligibility.criteria_summary: Non-farm income generating micro and small enterprises needing credit up to ₹10 lakh.

application_steps: Visit nearest bank, MFI or NBFC
Fill loan application with business details
Submit documents and get loan disbursed within 7-10 working days

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite loan from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
Repayment period up to 7 years with 18-month moratorium
Working capital limit through CC/OD facility
Credit guarantee through NCGTC

eligibility.criteria_summary: SC/ST or Women entrepreneurs above 18 years setting up greenfield enterprise.

application_steps: Apply online at standupmitra.in or visit bank branch
Submit detailed project report and business plan
Get mentor support through SIDBI/NABARD network

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Supports artisans and craftspeople from 18 traditional trades with end-to-end support including credit access, skill training, digital payments, and market linkage.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefits: Collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh in two tranches
5% concessional interest rate on first tranche of ₹1 lakh
Stipend of ₹500/day during skill training
PM Vishwakarma certificate and digital recognition

eligibility.criteria_summary: Artisans from 18 trades like carpenter, blacksmith, potter, weaver, etc.

application_steps: Visit PM Vishwakarma portal or nearest CSC
Complete biometric verification with Aadhaar
Enroll in skill training program and receive benefits

name: Startup India Initiative
description: Flagship initiative providing tax exemptions for 3 years, fund of funds, self-certification compliance, and fast-track patent examination to promote entrepreneurship.
benefits: Income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years out of 10
80% discount on patent filing fees
Access to ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds
Easier public procurement norms

beneficiary_types: DPIIT-recognized Startups (up to 10 years old, turnover < ₹100 crore)
eligibility.criteria_summary: Company incorporated as private limited, LLP or registered partnership, recognized by DPIIT, working on innovation.

application_steps: Register on Startup India portal at startupindia.gov.in
Apply for DPIIT recognition with business description
Get recognized and access all benefits

name: Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS)
description: Provides 100% government-backed additional emergency credit to MSMEs adversely affected, enabling business continuity and recovery with no additional collateral required.
benefits: Collateral-free additional credit up to 20-40% of outstanding
Government guarantees 100% of credit
Low interest rate capped at 9.25% for banks
4-year repayment with 1-year moratorium

eligibility.criteria_summary: MSMEs with existing credit exposure up to ₹50 crore and not NPA as of Feb 2020.

application_steps: Contact your existing lender (bank or NBFC)
Submit ECLGS application with business financials
Receive additional credit within 7 working days

name: Udyam Registration for MSMEs
description: Free, paperless, self-declaration-based MSME registration portal enabling businesses to get priority sector lending, government procurement preferences and other MSME benefits.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefits: Free registration and recognition as MSME
Access to priority sector bank credit
Government procurement preference up to 25%
Protection against delayed payments under MSMED Act

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any enterprise (manufacturing or services) with investment up to ₹250 crore and turnover up to ₹1,250 crore.

application_steps: Visit udyamregistration.gov.in
Enter Aadhaar number for OTP verification
Fill enterprise details and get instant Udyam Certificate

name: One District One Product (ODOP) Scheme
description: Promotes unique traditional and artisanal crafts of each district by providing financial support, skill development, market access and branding support to local entrepreneurs and artisans.
benefits: 35% credit-linked subsidy for plant and machinery
Free branding and packaging design support
Market linkage through government e-marketplaces
Skill training for local artisans and entrepreneurs

eligibility.criteria_summary: Individual artisans, SHGs, cooperatives and micro-enterprises producing district-specific products.

application_steps: Identify ODOP product of your district
Apply through state food processing department or portal
Submit DPR and get subsidy approval

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: One-stop portal for all government scholarships including pre-matric, post-matric and merit scholarships from central and state governments for SC, ST, OBC, minorities and economically weaker students.
benefits: Pre-matric scholarships from Class 1-10
Post-matric scholarships for 11th onwards and higher education
Merit cum means scholarships for professional courses
Direct bank transfer of scholarship amount

eligibility.criteria_summary: Students from SC/ST/OBC/Minority communities or EWS families with family income within limits.

application_steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar
Fill application with education and family details
Upload documents and submit before deadline
Track application status on NSP portal

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Provides one nutritious hot cooked meal to all children in government and government-aided schools up to Class 8 to improve school attendance, retention and nutritional status.
benefits: Free nutritious mid-day meal daily for all school children
Improves enrollment, attendance and retention in schools
Additional food security for children from poor families
100% funded by Central and State governments

eligibility.criteria_summary: All children enrolled in government/government-aided schools from Class 1 to 8.

application_steps: Enroll in nearest government or government-aided school
Benefit is automatic for all enrolled students
No separate application needed

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated scheme covering school education from pre-primary to Class 12 focusing on improving quality of education, inclusivity, free textbooks, uniforms, digital learning and infrastructure.
benefits: Free textbooks and uniforms for SC/ST/BPL girls and disabled students
Free bicycle for girls in Classes 6-8
Digital infrastructure for smart classrooms
Stipend for disabled students

eligibility.criteria_summary: All students from pre-primary to Class 12 in government schools. Special provisions for SC/ST/girls/disabled.

application_steps: Enroll in government school in your area
Benefits are provided automatically by school
For specific benefits like bicycle, apply through school principal

name: PM eVIDYA Digital Education Program
description: Provides multi-mode access to digital/online education through DIKSHA platform, SWAYAM MOOCs, educational TV channels (PM e-Vidya) and radio programs for all students.
benefits: Free access to SWAYAM online courses and certifications
DIKSHA digital content for all classes
12 dedicated educational TV channels (One Channel per class)
Educational radio programs for remote learners

eligibility.criteria_summary: Open to all students across India. SWAYAM courses open to anyone above Class 9.

application_steps: Register on SWAYAM portal at swayam.gov.in for free online courses
Download DIKSHA app for school-level content
Watch PM eVIDYA channels on Doordarshan for class-wise content

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) Scheme
description: Provides full interest subsidy on education loans for higher professional courses during moratorium period to students from economically weaker sections studying in recognized institutions.
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during moratorium (course + 1 year or 6 months after job)
For loans up to ₹7.5 lakh from scheduled banks
No collateral or third party guarantee required

eligibility.criteria_summary: Students from families with annual income up to ₹4.5 lakh pursuing UG/PG technical or professional courses.

application_steps: Apply for education loan from nationalized bank
Register on Vidya Lakshmi Portal at vidyalakshmi.co.in
Apply for CSIS subsidy through bank

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)
description: World's largest government-funded health insurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to bottom 40% of India's population.
benefits: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year
Covers 1,929 medical procedures including cancer, heart surgery
Cashless and paperless treatment at 24,000+ empaneled hospitals
Pre and post hospitalization expenses covered

eligibility.criteria_summary: Families identified based on Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data covering bottom 40% population.

application_steps: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555
Visit nearest empaneled hospital with Aadhaar
Show Golden Card or Aadhaar for cashless treatment

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Safe motherhood intervention scheme under NHM promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women by providing cash incentives for delivery at government health facilities.
benefits: Cash assistance up to ₹1,400 for rural deliveries in LPS states
₹700 for urban deliveries
ASHA worker support and accompaniment
Free institutional delivery services

eligibility.criteria_summary: All pregnant women from BPL/SC/ST families delivering at government/accredited health facilities.

application_steps: Register at nearest Sub-Health Center or PHC during pregnancy
Complete at least 3 antenatal check-ups
Deliver at government hospital and receive cash benefit within 7 days

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
description: Provides one-time financial assistance to BPL patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases requiring expensive treatment at super-specialty government hospitals.
benefits: One-time financial assistance up to ₹15 lakh for major diseases
Covers heart surgery, kidney transplant, cancer, liver surgery
Additional ₹20,000 for travel and other expenses
Treatment at government super-specialty hospitals

eligibility.criteria_summary: Patients below poverty line suffering from major diseases requiring treatment at super-specialty hospitals.

application_steps: Apply through Medical Superintendent of concerned hospital
Submit BPL certificate and medical diagnosis report
Receive approval and begin treatment

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
description: Ensures free, assured and comprehensive antenatal care to pregnant women on 9th of every month at government health facilities by specialist doctors with minimum stipulated package of services.
benefits: Free comprehensive antenatal check-up on 9th of every month
Services by specialist gynecologists and physicians
Free lab tests including hemoglobin, blood pressure, weight
Iron and calcium supplements provided free

eligibility.criteria_summary: All pregnant women in their 2nd and 3rd trimester (4th month onwards) regardless of income.

application_steps: Register at local PHC/CHC or Sub-Centre during pregnancy
Visit on 9th of every month for free check-up
Receive comprehensive services including lab tests

name: National Mental Health Programme (NMHP)
description: Ensures availability and accessibility of minimum mental health care for all citizens, integrating mental health services into general health systems through District Mental Health Programme (DMHP).
benefits: Free outpatient and inpatient mental health services
Free medicines for mental disorders at government hospitals
Icare helpline services and community awareness programs
Telepsychiatry services through NIMHANS

eligibility.criteria_summary: All citizens requiring mental health care. Priority given to severe mental disorders.

application_steps: Visit nearest District Mental Health Programme facility
Call iCall helpline at 9152987821 for counselling
Get referral from PHC to district hospital for specialized care

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas to eligible rural BPL households for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh assistance per unit in plains (₹1.30 lakh in hills)
₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM
90/95 days MGNREGS wage for unskilled labor
Convergence with schemes for electricity, gas, water connections

eligibility.criteria_summary: Identified through SECC 2011 data - houseless or those living in 0/1 room mud/thatched houses.

application_steps: Check eligibility through Gram Panchayat PMAY-G list
Register on awaassoft.nic.in if eligible
Complete house construction in phases and receive installments

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Mission to provide affordable housing to urban poor with Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) offering interest subsidy of 3-6.5% on home loans of ₹6-12 lakh.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh for EWS/LIG borrowers
Subsidy on loan up to ₹6-12 lakh for 20-year tenure
In-situ slum redevelopment with free housing
Government contribution of ₹1.5 lakh for beneficiary-led construction

beneficiary_types: Urban EWS/LIG/MIG Families Without Pucca House
eligibility.criteria_summary: EWS: income up to ₹3L, LIG: ₹3-6L, MIG-I: ₹6-12L, MIG-II: ₹12-18L. Must not own pucca house.

application_steps: Apply at pmaymis.gov.in or nearest bank for CLSS
Fill eligibility details and select appropriate income category
Get bank approval and receive interest subsidy upfront

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission
description: Reduces poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households by enabling them to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities through skill training and shelter support.
benefits: Shelter for urban homeless with 24x7 facilities
Support for street vendors with vending certificates
Skill training and placement for urban poor youth
Formation of SHGs and credit support

eligibility.criteria_summary: Urban homeless and poor families living in cities and towns.

application_steps: Contact local Urban Local Body (ULB) or Municipal Corporation
Register as urban homeless or street vendor
Access shelter or skill training program

name: PM SVAMITVA Scheme
description: Provides property rights to residents of rural areas by mapping land parcels using drone technology and issuing property cards to rural households that can be used as financial assets for loans.
benefits: Legal ownership document (Property Card) for rural abadi land
Can use property card as collateral for bank loans
Reduces property disputes and litigation
Enables monetization of rural property

eligibility.criteria_summary: All households residing in rural abadi (inhabited/residential) areas across India.

application_steps: Drone survey of your village abadi conducted by state
Verify your plot during public notification period
Receive property card from Gram Panchayat/state revenue dept

name: Victim Compensation Scheme (NALSA)
description: Provides compensation to victims of crime or their dependents who have suffered loss or injury including sexual violence, acid attacks, human trafficking by legal aid authorities.
benefits: Compensation up to ₹10 lakh for rape victims
Up to ₹8 lakh for acid attack survivors
Interim compensation can be provided within 2 months
Free legal aid through DLSA/SLSA

eligibility.criteria_summary: Victims of violent crimes, sexual offences, acid attacks, human trafficking or their dependents.

application_steps: File FIR with police or contact nearest Legal Services Authority
Apply to District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) with documents
Receive compensation after DLSA/court order

name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) Free Legal Aid
description: Provides free legal services to marginalized sections including women, SC/ST, children, differently-abled, victims of disasters, industrial workers and persons in custody through LSAs.
benefits: Free legal representation in courts by empaneled lawyers
Free legal advice and consultation
Lok Adalat for quick settlement of disputes
Translation and interpretation services

eligibility.criteria_summary: Women, SC/ST, persons with disabilities, children, persons in custody, victims of disasters, and those with annual income below ₹3 lakh.

application_steps: Visit nearest District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) office
Fill application form with case details
Get legal aid lawyer assigned within 7 days

name: Women Help Desk at Police Stations
description: Dedicated help desks at police stations to handle complaints related to violence against women, provide guidance, first information and liaison with support services.
benefits: 24x7 helpline 112 for emergency and 1091 for women
Dedicated women police officers at help desks
Fast-track registration of FIRs
Referral to One Stop Centres and NGOs

beneficiary_types: Women Facing Any Form of Violence or Harassment
eligibility.criteria_summary: Any woman who is a victim of violence, harassment, stalking, acid attack or any crime.

application_steps: Call 112 (emergency) or 1091 (women helpline)
Visit nearest police station's Women Help Desk
File complaint and receive assistance

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: Online portal to report cybercrime complaints including financial fraud, online harassment, morphed images, hacking and provide immediate action mechanism for financial fraud cases.
benefits: 24x7 online complaint registration at cybercrime.gov.in
Helpline 1930 for immediate financial fraud reporting
Quick freeze of fraudulent transactions within hours
Anonymous reporting option for sensitive cases

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any citizen who has been a victim of any type of cybercrime including financial fraud, harassment, hacking.

application_steps: Call 1930 immediately for financial fraud
File report at cybercrime.gov.in or visit cyber cell
Note complaint number and follow up

name: BSNL Bharat Fiber (FTTH) Rural Connectivity
description: High-speed optical fiber broadband connectivity to rural areas through BharatNet project enabling last-mile connectivity at affordable rates to villages and gram panchayats.
benefits: High-speed broadband up to 300 Mbps at ₹399/month
Free Wi-Fi hotspots at Gram Panchayats
OTT platforms bundled at no extra cost
Free installation in many rural plans

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any household or enterprise in areas covered by BharatNet optical fiber network.

application_steps: Check BharatNet coverage at bsnl.in for your village
Apply online or visit BSNL exchange/CSC
Get fiber connection installed within 7-10 days

name: Digital India Programme
description: Transforms India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy through digital infrastructure, digital services delivery and digital literacy across all segments.
benefits: Access to 600+ government services online via umang.gov.in
DigiLocker for digital documents storage and sharing
Common Service Centers for citizen services in rural areas
PM Wani Wi-Fi hotspot scheme for affordable internet

eligibility.criteria_summary: All Indian citizens. DigiLocker available to anyone with Aadhaar/mobile number.

application_steps: Download UMANG app from app store
Create DigiLocker account at digilocker.gov.in
Access 600+ services from one platform

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
description: Makes rural India digitally literate by providing digital literacy training to rural households covering computer basics, internet usage, digital payments and online services.
benefits: Free 20-hour digital literacy training
Training on computer, internet, mobile and digital payments
Certificate recognized by government for employment
Training provided at nearest CSC or training center

eligibility.criteria_summary: Rural household members who are not digitally literate. Priority to SC/ST, minorities, BPL, differently abled.

application_steps: Register at pmgdisha.in or visit nearest CSC
Complete 20-hour training at convenience
Take online assessment and receive certificate

name: ISRO Space Technology Applications for Rural Development
description: Leverages satellite technology for village resource mapping, telemedicine, tele-education, disaster management and weather forecasting for rural and remote areas.
benefits: Remote sensing data for agricultural planning
Telemedicine via satellite to remote areas
Real-time weather data for farmers
Disaster early warning systems

eligibility.criteria_summary: Rural communities, government agencies, research institutions and educational institutions.

application_steps: Contact ISRO Space Application Centre or NRSC
Apply for specific space-based services relevant to your need
Access data through ISRO portals like bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Flagship scheme for skill development enabling large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them in securing better livelihood across 30+ sectors.
benefits: Free skill training in 300+ job roles across 30+ sectors
Monetary reward up to ₹8,000 on skill certification
Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) certification
Placement assistance through training partner network

eligibility.criteria_summary: Indian youth aged 15-45 years who are school/college dropouts or seeking better employment.

application_steps: Visit skillindiadigital.gov.in and find nearest training center
Enroll in desired skill course
Complete training, appear for assessment and receive certificate

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Fellowship (MGNF)
description: Two-year fellowship for young graduates to work with district administration on skill development and livelihood initiatives, earning ₹50,000 per month stipend.
benefits: ₹50,000 monthly stipend for 2 years
Intensive training at IIM campuses
Hands-on district-level development experience
Certificate from IIM upon completion

eligibility.criteria_summary: Indian graduates aged 21-30 years from any discipline with strong academic record.

application_steps: Apply online during fellowship announcement cycle
Appear for written test and interview
Selected fellows undergo IIM training before district posting

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing 25% of stipend cost with employers and providing basic training cost support for fresher apprentices to increase industry engagement.
benefits: 25% stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) shared by government with employer
Basic training cost reimbursement up to ₹7,500
Structured on-the-job training at industry
National Apprenticeship Certificate upon completion

eligibility.criteria_summary: Youth above 14 years with at least Class 8 pass who want to learn a trade through apprenticeship.

application_steps: Register on apprenticeshipindia.org
Find apprenticeship openings in desired trade and location
Apply and join the apprenticeship program

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro enterprises in non-farm sector with margin money subsidy of 15-35%.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15-35% of project cost
Maximum project cost ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for services
Both urban and rural entrepreneurs eligible
SC/ST and women get 10% additional subsidy

eligibility.criteria_summary: Any Indian citizen above 18 years with Class 8 pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing).

application_steps: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegp
Get project appraised by KVIC/KVIB/DIC
Receive bank approval and margin money subsidy

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Provides additional 5 kg free food grain per person per month over and above the entitlement under NFSA to beneficiaries to meet their nutritional needs.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
benefits: 5 kg free food grain per person per month
1 kg free pulses per household per month
Covers rice, wheat or coarse grains based on entitlement
Distributed through existing PDS network

beneficiary_types: NFSA Beneficiaries - PHH and AAY Card Holders
eligibility.criteria_summary: Households covered under National Food Security Act with Priority Household or Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration cards.

application_steps: Ensure Aadhaar is linked to ration card
Visit nearest Fair Price Shop (ration shop) with ration card
Collect free food grains using biometric or OTP verification

name: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Provides concessional loans to SC persons living below double poverty line for income-generating activities in agriculture, manufacturing, services and allied sectors.
benefits: Loans at 2-6% concessional interest rate
Term loans up to ₹30 lakh for various projects
Mahila Samridhi Yojana for SC women - ₹1.40 lakh at 4%
Shilp Samridhi Yojana for SC artisans

beneficiary_types: SC Persons Below Double Poverty Line
eligibility.criteria_summary: Scheduled Caste persons with family income up to ₹1.62 lakh per annum in rural areas, ₹2.10 lakh in urban areas.

application_steps: Contact State Channelizing Agency (SCA) in your state
Submit application with project plan and income documents
Receive loan at concessional interest rate

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) - ODF & Cleanliness
description: Aims to achieve universal sanitation coverage and eliminate open defecation by constructing Individual Household Latrines (IHHLs) with incentive support of ₹12,000.
benefits: ₹12,000 incentive for toilet construction in rural areas
Technical assistance and design support
Community awareness and hygiene promotion
Solid and liquid waste management support

eligibility.criteria_summary: Rural households without a toilet facility, especially BPL families, SC/ST, and households headed by women.

application_steps: Apply through Gram Panchayat Pradhan or Block Development Officer
Get toilet construction verified by Gram Panchayat
Receive ₹12,000 incentive directly in bank account

name: Khelo India Programme
description: Revives sports culture at grassroots level through scholarships to talented young athletes, upgrading sports infrastructure, running annual sports games at school and university level.
benefits: ₹5 lakh per year scholarship for 8 years to identified athletes
Access to Sports Authority of India training centers
Khelo India Games platform for competitive exposure
Sports science support including nutrition and physiotherapy

eligibility.criteria_summary: Talented young athletes aged 10-18 years who excel in recognized sports at district/state level.

application_steps: Participate in Khelo India School/University Games
Get recommended by State Sports Authority
Get identified by Selection Committee and receive scholarship

name: Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)
description: Mission mode programme to support elite athletes who have potential to win medals at the next Olympic/Paralympic Games with financial assistance, training abroad and equipment support.
benefits: Monthly stipend up to ₹50,000 for core group athletes
Funding for training abroad at best academies
Procurement of specialized equipment
Access to best coaches nationally and internationally

eligibility.criteria_summary: Elite athletes identified by Mission Olympic Cell based on performance potential for next Olympics.

application_steps: Be nominated by National Sports Federation (NSF)
Appear before Mission Olympic Cell for evaluation
Get included in Development or Core Group and receive support

name: National Culture Fund (NCF)
description: Leverages private sector funding for conservation of cultural heritage, performing arts, intangible heritage promotion and making culture accessible to common citizens.
benefits: Grants for conservation of heritage monuments and sites
Support for traditional performing arts and folk art forms
Cultural festival funding and documentation grants
Stipends for senior traditional artists

eligibility.criteria_summary: Traditional artists, cultural organizations, museums and heritage conservation institutions.

application_steps: Contact Ministry of Culture or NCF secretariat
Submit project proposal with budget breakdown
Get project approved and receive grant funds

name: PM Gati Shakti - National Master Plan
description: Integrated multimodal connectivity project worth ₹100+ lakh crore for seamless integration of 16 ministries, creating unified infrastructure for roads, railways, ports, airports, waterways.
benefits: Integrated infrastructure development reducing logistics costs
Employment generation through large infrastructure projects
Better connectivity between rural areas and markets
Digital portal for real-time project tracking

eligibility.criteria_summary: All businesses, state governments and citizens who benefit from improved infrastructure connectivity.

application_steps: Access PM Gati Shakti portal for infrastructure project data
Businesses can use GIS-based planning for site selection
Contact respective ministry for project participation

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations with population of 500+ (250+ in hilly/tribal/desert areas) through quality road construction.
benefits: All-weather road connectivity to remote villages
Employment generation for local population during construction
Improved access to markets, schools and hospitals
Upgradation of existing rural roads

eligibility.criteria_summary: Rural habitations with population of 500+ (250+ in hilly/tribal/desert/LWE areas) without all-weather road connectivity.

application_steps: Village Panchayat or Block Development Officer submits proposal
State government identifies unconnected habitations
Road construction undertaken by state through approved contractors

name: Metro Rail Policy & Subsidy Scheme
description: Central government provides 20% equity for metro rail projects in cities with population above 10 lakh with requirement of modern features, sustainability and fare concessions for poor.
benefits: Affordable metro rail infrastructure in major cities
Concession tickets for students, disabled and senior citizens
Reduced traffic congestion and pollution
Zero-emission public transit option

eligibility.criteria_summary: All urban commuters in cities with metro rail. Special concessions for students, senior citizens and persons with disabilities.

application_steps: Purchase metro smart card from metro stations
Apply for concession card if eligible (student/senior/disabled)
Use metro daily and recharge as needed

name: Incredible India - Tourism Development Scheme
description: Promotes tourism in India through development of world-class tourist infrastructure, marketing campaigns, pilgrimage rejuvenation, eco-tourism and PRASHAD scheme for religious sites.
benefits: Infrastructure development at tourist destinations
Subsidized training for tourism hospitality workers
Recognition and support for tourism startups
Eco-tourism development in national parks

eligibility.criteria_summary: Tourism businesses, guides, hospitality workers and entrepreneurs in the tourism sector.

application_steps: Apply for tourism business license with state tourism department
Enroll guides for Ministry of Tourism approved guide training
Apply for PRASHAD scheme benefits for religious tourism sites

name: PRASHAD Scheme - Pilgrimage Rejuvenation & Spiritual Augmentation Drive
description: Develops integrated pilgrimage tourism destinations by creating facilities like amenities, connectivity, interpretation centers and heritage circuits around religious sites.
benefits: World-class infrastructure at 15+ pilgrimage sites
Better roads, toilets and rest facilities at religious places
LED lighting and beautification of religious complexes
Employment for local communities in tourism sector

eligibility.criteria_summary: Local communities, tourism workers and religious trusts at identified pilgrimage destinations.

application_steps: Contact local tourism department in pilgrimage city
Register as local tourism service provider
Benefit from improved infrastructure at pilgrimage sites

name: Swadesh Darshan Scheme
description: Develops integrated theme-based tourist circuits covering religious, heritage, eco, wildlife, adventure, coastal, rural and other themes with financial assistance to states.
benefits: Development of theme-based tourist circuits in states
Infrastructure for eco-tourism, adventure and heritage tourism
Employment opportunities for local guides and hospitality workers
Online booking platforms for tourism packages

eligibility.criteria_summary: Tourism industry workers, local communities at circuit destinations, and tourism businesses.

application_steps: Check swadeshdarshan.gov.in for circuit information
Contact state tourism corporation for scheme details
Register as tourism service provider in identified circuits

name: Jal Jeevan Mission - Har Ghar Jal
description: Ensures tap water supply to every rural household by 2024 with functional household tap connections providing 55 liters per capita per day of potable water of prescribed quality.
benefits: Functional tap water connection to every rural household
55 liters per capita per day of safe drinking water
Water quality testing at village level
Employment for local water supply management

eligibility.criteria_summary: All rural households without functional tap water connection, priority to SC/ST hamlets and aspirational districts.

application_steps: Contact Gram Panchayat for water connection application
Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC) facilitates connection
Pay nominal user charges after installation

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides clean cooking fuel by giving free LPG connections to BPL households below poverty line with deposit-free connection to safeguard health of women and reduce indoor air pollution.
benefits: Free LPG connection with cylinder and pressure regulator
₹1,600 financial assistance per connection
First refill cylinder at subsidized/free rates
EMI facility for purchase of hot plate and first refill

beneficiary_types: BPL Women Household Heads Without LPG
eligibility.criteria_summary: Women from BPL households aged 18+ without an existing LPG connection in the household.

application_steps: Visit nearest LPG distributor with Aadhaar and BPL certificate
Fill PMUY application form
Receive free connection with first refill within 7 days

name: Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana (Saubhagya)
description: Provides electricity connections to all un-electrified households in rural and urban areas to ensure universal household electrification and improve quality of life.
benefits: Free electricity connection for BPL households
Battery backup with 5 LED lights and 1 DC fan for remote areas
5-year repair and maintenance support
Connection provided at doorstep through state utilities

eligibility.criteria_summary: Un-electrified households - BPL households get free connection, others pay ₹500 in 10 easy installments.

application_steps: Contact state electricity utility or DISCOM
Apply for new connection with Aadhaar verification
Receive connection within 7 days of application

name: GOBAR-Dhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources) Scheme
description: Converts cattle dung and agricultural waste into biogas/CNG and organic manure to reduce pollution, generate energy and improve sanitation in rural areas.
benefits: Subsidy for biogas plant installation
Reduces dependence on fossil fuels and firewood
Generates quality organic manure as byproduct
Income generation from selling biogas and manure

eligibility.criteria_summary: Farmers and rural households with cattle who want to set up biogas plants.

application_steps: Contact state MNRE office or NABARD for support
Apply through village-level committee or Gram Panchayat
Get biogas plant constructed by empaneled agency

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) Scheme
description: Addresses declining child sex ratio and empowers girl children through prevention of gender-biased sex selective elimination and education of girl children across India.
benefits: Community awareness programs against female foeticide
Incentives for girl child education and birth registration
Felicitation of families with girl children
Convergent support with SSA, ICDS and health programs

eligibility.criteria_summary: Girl children from birth to 18 years and their families, especially in districts with low sex ratio.

application_steps: Register girl child birth at hospital or Gram Panchayat
Contact Anganwadi worker for ICDS benefits
Enroll girl in school under SSA provisions

name: Sukanya Samridhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small savings scheme for girl children offering highest interest rate among post office savings at 8.2% p.a. with tax benefits under Section 80C for parents/guardians.
benefits: 8.2% per annum interest rate - highest among small savings
Tax exemption on deposits under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh
Interest earned and maturity amount fully tax-free
Partial withdrawal for education at age 18

eligibility.criteria_summary: Girl child below age 10 years. Maximum 2 accounts per family, exception for twins.

application_steps: Visit nearest post office or authorized bank branch
Fill SSY account opening form
Deposit minimum ₹250 to open account (max ₹1.5 lakh/year)

name: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) - Anganwadi
description: World's largest early childhood program providing supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, referral services, pre-school education and nutrition & health education to children under 6 and mothers.
benefits: Free supplementary nutrition for children and pregnant/nursing mothers
Free immunization and health check-ups for children 0-6 years
Pre-school non-formal education for 3-6 year olds
Nutrition counselling and health education for mothers

eligibility.criteria_summary: Children aged 0-6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers, especially from disadvantaged sections.

application_steps: Visit nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) in your area
Register with Anganwadi worker
Receive services automatically as enrolled beneficiary

name: Mahila Shakti Kendra (MSK) Scheme
description: Empowers rural women through community engagement and convergence of government programs providing them access to their rights and entitlements with training and capacity building.
benefits: Skill training and entrepreneurship development for rural women
Awareness programs about legal rights and entitlements
Digital literacy training for rural women
Convergence of 8 government schemes for women's empowerment

beneficiary_types: Rural Women in Block Level MSK Areas
eligibility.criteria_summary: All rural women in areas covered by Mahila Shakti Kendra, priority to marginalized communities.

application_steps: Visit nearest Anganwadi or Gram Panchayat for MSK contact
Enroll with Mahila Shakti Kendra through village college student volunteers
Attend skill and awareness training sessions

name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) Scheme
description: Provides integrated support and assistance to women affected by violence - medical, legal, psychological counselling, temporary shelter, police assistance and court support under one roof.
benefits: Emergency rescue and temporary shelter (up to 5 days)
Medical assistance and emergency contraception
Police assistance and FIR registration
Legal aid and psychological counselling
Court support and follow-up

beneficiary_types: Women and Girls Affected by Any Form of Violence
eligibility.criteria_summary: Women and girls of all ages affected by violence in private or public spaces - domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking etc.

application_steps: Call Women Helpline 181 for referral
Visit nearest One Stop Centre / Sakhi Centre
Receive immediate multi-services support under one roof

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Provides maternity benefit of ₹5,000 for first living child to pregnant and lactating mothers to compensate for wage loss during pregnancy and child-rearing and improve health seeking behavior.
benefits: ₹5,000 cash incentive in 3 installments for first child
Additional ₹6,000 for second child if it is a girl
Covers private sector and informal workers
Paid directly to beneficiary's bank account

beneficiary_types: Pregnant & Lactating Women for First Living Child
eligibility.criteria_summary: All pregnant and lactating women (except central/state government employees) for first living child.

application_steps: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre or Health facility
Fill PMMVY application form
Receive installments on completing registration, 6-month ANC and childbirth registration
